title: Modular Power Queries
statement:
Use binary exponentiation to compute a to the power b modulo m. The value for exponent zero is 1 modulo m, including when a=0.

Input
q, then q triples a b m.

Output
Print one residue per query.

Constraints
1 ≤ q ≤ 100000. a and b are unsigned 64-bit integers, and 1 ≤ m ≤ 2⁶⁴−1.
